6. U.S. note 2(v) of subchapter Ill of chapter 99 of the HTSUS is modified by:
i. renumbering subdivisions (xiii) through (xix) as (xiv) through (xx), respectively;

ii. adding new subdivision (xiii), in numerical order:

“The additional duties imposed by headings 9903.01.25, 9903.01.35, 9903.01.39,
9903.01.63, and 9903.02.01-9903.02.73 shall apply to wood products provided for in
heading 9903.76.04, but shall not apply to wood products provided for in headings
9903.76.01, 9903.76.02, 9903.76.03, 9903.76.20, 9903.76.21, and 9903.76.22.”

iii. by deleting the following from the list of HTSUS provisions in subdivision (iii):
